strip_selection.procedure: Per-image CSVs of the 195-prompt evaluation (eval/a4k195_main base and extra) ranked the prompts not shown elsewhere in the paper and not used in development by SCA's ImageReward + MUSIQ_c + HPSv2.1 percentiles, keeping prompts where each of DyPE, SEGA, AReA and UltraImage has ImageReward and HPSv2.1 at or above its own 25th percentile. Shortlisted prompts were viewed as six-method contact sheets, then SCA whole and at native pixels; prompts where SCA repeated or added subjects were rejected.

rejected.4820545723762191815: SCA: five moons and two extra small bears
rejected.minus2670470656524755471: SCA: spray speckle around the umbrellas, extra small figures
rejected.minus3268147817845827695: its prompt asks for a lone figure and SCA adds about three small pedestrians; the sheep prompt was preferred (it was briefly in Figure zoom4k and was replaced there for the same reason)
rejected.minus3413373481783671760: clean, but SCA's own scores are near its median (ImageReward p42)

strip_selection.values: at selection (published operator, sca_nb), percentiles within each method's own 195 images, ImageReward/MUSIQ_c/HPSv2.1: SCA 57/79/89 (ImageReward 1.52, MUSIQ_c 70.9); DyPE 37/54/53; SEGA 47/90/33; AReA 36/49/51; UltraImage 41/53/69; full attention's ImageReward sits at its usual floor (-2.28)
strip_selection.reason: Sheep in snow before a stone church. Full attention is a flat field; DyPE and SEGA cover the scene in a fine lattice; AReA, UltraImage and SCA keep the church and the flock. SCA's image is clean at native pixels (stonework, windows, the flock); a distant town church is a separate building, not a copy of the main one.
strip_selection.crop: Shared native window placed by hand on SCA's church tower (x, y, side in pixels); AReA and UltraImage also show church walls and windows there, so the crops compare stone, glass and snow detail like for like.

previous_strip.dropped_because: baselines far below their own medians

timing_definitions.campaign: mean over the 195-prompt evaluation on shared nodes, the camp. column of Table 1 (results/<run>/base_summary.csv, metric seconds)
timing_definitions.clean: not recorded: the final operator's clean batch-1 latency is pending, so no clean time or speedup appears in the figure, its caption or this record

metrics_definition: ImageReward and HPSv2.1 (x100), means over the 195 evaluation prompts at 4096x4096, as in Table 1
